press_bio.es: GORRIóN es una productora audiovisual independiente con sede en La Habana. Desde 2018 produce ficción, documental, series y videoclips con equipos pequeños y una mirada cercana a la vida cotidiana. Sus películas se han presentado en festivales de América Latina.
press_bio.en: GORRIóN is an independent audiovisual production company based in Havana. Since 2018 it has produced fiction, documentary, series and music videos with small crews and a close-up look at everyday life. Its films have been shown at festivals across Latin America.
